title: OnePlus 16 launch teased, 165Hz system-wide refresh rate confirmed
description: We’ve heard plenty about the OnePlus 16 through leaks and rumors, but the company has remained quiet about the upcoming flagship until now. OnePlus has officially teased the phone’s launch in China and confirmed some of its key specifications. In a post on Weibo, the company teased the launch of the OnePlus 16, saying that the phone is coming soon. A recent leak suggested that the flagship could be unveiled in October. OnePlus has confirmed that the phone will run Android 17 based ColorOS 17. The company also revealed that the OnePlus 16 will support a system-wide 165Hz refresh...

title: Google Pixel 11 review
Honor Win 2 and Win 2 RT get certified
description: According to the prolific leaker who goes by Digital Chat Station on Weibo, Honor's upcoming Win 2 and Win 2 RT smartphones may have just been certified for sale in China. The Win 2 supports 100W wired charging and the Win 2 RT goes up to 90W. That would be an interesting downgrade for the more affordable model, as the original Win RT supported 100W wired charging too. Anyway, DCS says the Win 2 will be the only phone released this year to pair Qualcomm’s Snapdragon 8 Elite Gen 6 chipset with a battery over 10,000 mAh, a powerful built-in cooling fan, and an ultra-high refresh rate display...

title: iQOO shows the Pad Ultra and its dedicated gaming accessories
description: iQOO is launching the Pad Ultra in China on September 29 alongside the iQOO 16 smartphone. The company has, in the past few days, shown us the phone, and today it has decided to also present the tablet. So here it is in all its glory, the iQOO Pad Ultra. iQOO will offer a dual-sided gamepad for the device as well as a case with clip-on handles. Both of these are advertised as e-sports oriented, so clearly the tablet will be all about gaming. iQOO Pad Ultra official images The iQOO Pad Ultra will be available in silver and black. It has an 8.8-inch screen and weighs just...

title: Xiaomi 18 Pro runs Geekbench confirming its chipset
description: Yesterday Xiaomi finally started to officially tease the upcoming 18 Pro series, revealing that the Xiaomi 18 Pro and Xiaomi 18 Pro Max will be unveiled later this month (an exact date is yet to be announced). Today a Xiaomi device powered by the upcoming Snapdragon 8 Elite Gen 6 Pro SoC was spotted in the Geekbench online database with the model number M154FF. That is a very new way for Xiaomi to do model numbers, by the way, as the company has so far been using a system that starts with the year and month. We're not saying the listing is fake, just that it's got a surprising model...

title: Honor MagicOS 11 debuts with liquid glass design and more capable AI
description: Honor announced its take on Android 17 with MagicOS 11 today at its Global Developer Conference. It brings an iOS-inspired liquid glass design, which Honor developed using its custom Luminous and Hummingbird base architectures. They optimize the user interface dynamics, AI processing, and hardware performance. Honor claims that despite the fancy new look, MagicOS 11 brings up to 20% faster system animations compared to MagicOS 10. The new system also features updated icons, menu items, widgets and customizable tinting for the home screen icons and dock. The other key addition...

title: The iPhone 18 Pro Max is the fastest-charging iPhone ever
description: Apple's iPhone 18 Pro Max will charge faster than any other iPhone ever. According to a new post by Ice Universe on X, the device goes from 0 to 50% charge in just 15 minutes. That is in fact what Apple claimed during the announcement. [#InlinePriceWidget,14716,1#] The iPhone 18 Pro Max takes just 10 minutes to reach 34%, and reports 100% charge after 55 minutes. However, it only stops charging after 76 minutes. In our review of its predecessor, we noted that it reached 38% after 15 minutes, and displayed 100% after 72 minutes. It drew a peak of 35W, whereas the iPhone 18 Pro Max can...

title: SK Hynix reportedly wants Intel to make its memory chips in the US
description: According to a new report from Reuters, SK Hynix is now in talks with Intel about a potential deal that would see the Korean company manufacture memory chips in the US for the first time. There are apparently two ways this can go: either SK Hynix will lease part of Intel's chip factory in Ohio, or it could form a joint venture with Intel as well as some unnamed "major cloud firms that are keen to lock in memory chip supplies". This all comes from "people familiar with the matter", so nothing is confirmed or official yet. A deal with SK Hynix would help Intel get out of its current not...

title: Meta is working on a pair of smart glasses without a camera, new report claims
description: Meta's smart glasses have been quite successful so far, but many people may not need or want a pair with a camera. Thankfully, the company seems intent on serving those people too, if a new report turns out to be accurate. Meta is allegedly developing a pair of smart glasses without a camera. These will be called Luna. They are expected to be unveiled during Meta's annual developer conference scheduled to take place on September 23 and 24. The Meta Luna will then ship in October, apparently. These are the Meta Glasses with a camera The new glasses will have six built-in microphones...

title: Microsoft announces October 7 Windows and Surface event
description: It has been more than two years since Microsoft held a major event, but that is about to change. The company has announced a Windows and Surface event for next month to share new details about AI, Windows, the Surface Laptop Ultra, and the Nvidia RTX Spark. According to Engadget, the event will be held in San Francisco on October 7. The event will focus on local AI on Windows PCs, while Microsoft is also expected to announce the availability and pricing of the Surface Laptop Ultra, which was unveiled in June. Microsoft CEO Satya Nadella, Microsoft Executive Vice President of...

title: The September Pixel Drop improves the VIP contacts widget, adds Harry Potter themes
description: The September Pixel Drop is here – it brings key improvements to the VIP contacts widget, adds even more scam protections, expands Pause Point availability to older models and even celebrates the release of the new Harry Potter audiobooks. All Pixel devices going back to the Pixel 6 series are eligible for this update except for the Pixel Tablet. Do note that while the rollout starts today, it will happen in stages and some models (especially carrier phones) may get it in the coming weeks rather than today. Also – and this is important – some of these features are region and language...

title: Samsung's Gallery Cloud Sync app adds Google Photos support just as it drops OneDrive
description: You know how Samsung offers a 6-month trial of the Google AI Pro plan for free with select Galaxy devices? Beyond the AI features, that plan also gives you 5TB of cloud storage – and soon you will be able to use that more easily, thanks to an upcoming change. A new version of the Gallery Cloud Sync system app (v1.6.09.31) adds Google Photos integration. This is set to go live on October first – the day after Samsung drops OneDrive support. Technically, this move replaces Microsoft’s cloud storage service with a Samsung-native one – Samsung Cloud. However, that only gives you 15GB for...

title: nubia NaviX Ultra launches with an advanced agentic AI, Snapdragon 8 Elite Gen 5 power
description: The nubia NaviX Ultra, the brand’s AI agentic phone, is now official. The phone is built around the Doubao Mobile Assistant, which supports deep reasoning, self-correction, extended-context adherence and generalization. Okay, that might be confusing if you are not deep into AI. Deep reasoning means that the AI can create a plan that splits a complex task into simpler sub-tasks. Divide and conquer, basically. Self-correction allows the AI to recover a task that ran into unexpected problems. AI models can drift off when running long tasks, extended-context adherence helps keep Doubao on...

title: Honor shows off ARRI Look Cinematic Video filters for the upcoming Magic9 series
description: Honor partnered with German camera maker ARRI and has been really leaning into the cinematography connection to build buzz for the upcoming Magic9 series. For example, the Honor Magic9 Pro Max made a public appearance at the 83rd Venice Film Festival. It’s only natural for Honor to leverage this partnership further and together with ARRI, it has built a collection of filters called “ARRI Look Cinematic Video”. These can be applied with a single tap and alter the color grading of the phone’s camera to match that of one of several ARRI cameras. Additionally, the user can adjust the color...

title: Oppo Find X10 series emerges in hands-on shots ahead of launch
description: Oppo is set to unveil its Find X10 series smartphones next week in China with three members. And ahead of the big launch, display units of the Find X10 E, Find X10 and Find X10 Pro Max were spotted in what appears to be an official vivo store in China. Oppo Find X10 E The Find X10 E brings a familiar look to last year’s Find X9 and will be the more affordable entry in the Find X10 lineup. It’s expected to bring a triple camera setup with 50MP sensors and a 7,000 mAh battery. The phone will be available in Ice Blue and Light Titanium colors with two RAM/storage trims – 12/256GB and...

title: Xiaomi will let you use AI to build apps for the 18 Pro's rear display
description: As promised, Xiaomi has shared more details about the “versatile rear display” coming to the upcoming Xiaomi 18 Pro series. The company offered a first look at the upgraded rear display yesterday. In a short teaser video shared on Weibo, Xiaomi revealed that users will be able to create AI-powered apps for specific tasks that will appear on the rear display. The video showcases several examples, including apps for drinking water reminders, egg cooking timers, recipe recommendations, and learning new English words. Previously, the rear display on the Xiaomi 17 Pro series was limited...

title: Samsung officially releases One UI 9 for the Galaxy S26, S26+, and S26 Ultra
description: Following a months-long beta testing period, today Samsung is finally releasing the stable version of One UI 9 based on Android 17 for the Galaxy S26, S26+, and S26 Ultra. The update will start rolling out in various markets, and it seems like Samsung's home country of South Korea got it first as a 650ish MB over-the-air download. Samsung highlights My FanCam as one of the key new features in One UI 9. You can see this in action below. You can also create and edit your own cards for the Now Brief using generative AI, as shown in the video below. ...

title: Oppo K14 Lite is official with a 7,000mAh battery
description: Oppo’s K14 lineup in India has gained a new member. The Oppo K14 Lite is a budget 4G smartphone featuring a 7,000mAh battery and a 6.75-inch display. The Oppo K14 Lite is powered by the Unisoc T7250 chipset, paired with 4GB of RAM and 64GB of UFS 2.2 storage. It is priced at INR 16,999 and is available in Feather Purple and Stone Brown colorways. As a budget 4G smartphone, the Oppo K14 Lite offers fairly modest specs. It features a 6.75-inch LCD display with an HD+ resolution and a 120Hz refresh rate. For photography, the phone gets a 13MP rear camera with autofocus and a 5MP...

title: Samsung might stick to LPDDR5X memory for its lower-tier Galaxy S27 devices
description: Earlier reports claimed that the Samsung Galaxy S27 lineup will ship with the next-generation LPDDR6 memory, paired with Qualcomm's upcoming Snapdragon 8 Elite Extreme Gen 6, but the latest rumor suggests otherwise. The Bell cites inside sources claiming that Samsung is carrying out quality tests using Micron's new LPDDR5X memory based on the 1y process, which is the equivalent of the 1c DRAM manufacturing process from Samsung and SK Hynix. Due to rising RAM costs, Micron is reportedly asking for a 50% higher price than Samsung's Device Solutions arm that produces DRAM chips....

title: Honor Magic9 Pro Max runs Geekbench, reveals its chipset and RAM amount
description: The Honor Magic9 Pro Max has seemingly been spotted in the Geekbench online database with the model number WKL-AN20. The Geekbench run reveals that it's powered by the Snapdragon 8 Elite Gen 6 chipset (though not which specific variant of it). The prototype which ran the benchmark had 16GB of RAM and ran Android 17. So the Honor Magic9 Pro Max will launch running Android 17 most likely, but other RAM options may be available too. As for the results, keep in mind that this is a prototype device which may not contain finalized hardware and software, and also that it ran Geekbench 6.7.1 and...
